title: prunella grandiflora
intro: Prunella grandiflora, commonly known as Selfheal or Heal-all, is a perennial flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Prunella grandiflora include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its traditional use as a treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
